title.zh: 为执行第1082号共和国法目的、在1955至1956财政年度追加拨款四十万比索的法案
title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Four Hundred Thousand Pesos as Additional Fund to Carry Out the Purposes of Republic Act Numbered Ten Hundred Eighty-Two for the Fiscal Year Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Five to Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Six
title.orig: An Act Appropriating the Sum of Four Hundred Thousand Pesos as Additional Fund to Carry Out the Purposes of Republic Act Numbered Ten Hundred Eighty-Two for the Fiscal Year Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Five to Nineteen Hundred Fifty-Six
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp thêm ngân sách bốn trăm nghìn peso cho năm tài chính 1955–1956 nhằm thực hiện mục đích của Đạo luật Cộng hòa Số 1082
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดสรรงบประมาณเพิ่มเติมสี่แสนเปโซสำหรับปีงบประมาณ พ.ศ. 2498–2499 เพื่อดำเนินการตามวัตถุประสงค์ของพระราชบัญญัติสาธารณรัฐฉบับที่ 1082
title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Pengalokasian Tambahan Empat Ratus Ribu Peso untuk Tahun Anggaran 1955–1956 guna Melaksanakan Tujuan Undang-Undang Republik Nomor 1082
title.ms: Akta bagi Peruntukan Tambahan Empat Ratus Ribu Peso untuk Tahun Perakaunan 1955–1956 bagi Melaksanakan Tujuan Akta Republik Nombor 1082

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1338_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sum of four hundred thousand pesos is appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, as additional fund to carry out the purposes of Republic Act Numbered Ten hundred eighty-two for the fiscal year nineteen hundred fifty-five to nineteen hundred fifty-six.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
